messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@brightcart.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Emergency: short hourly burst window needed today (billing question)

Hi Rafael,

Quick one — we just pushed a flash promotion and are seeing a 3x spike in inference traffic on our checkout path. Traffic started ~08:50 PT and is still ramping. Our current committed throughput will throttle checkout calls and impact conversion.

Can Redwood authorize a short hourly burst window (6 hours max) for BrightCart to avoid failed checkouts? If possible we need:
- immediate uplift to +250% throughput (or an explicit hourly cap we can rely on)
- preserve request latency (we can't move to a slower model)

On billing — if we overshoot committed units we'd prefer a retroactive, pro-rated arrangement (some credit or cap) vs. immediate punitive overrun charges. We can provide traffic curves and the promo plan (attached).

Peak window estimate: today 11:00–17:00 PT (we'll confirm), expected extra tokens ~1.8M over that 6h window.

Can you confirm feasibility and a billing approach ASAP? We have Ops on standby: ops@brightcart.com.

Thanks,
Julia Park
Head of Platform
BrightCart

Attachments: promo_plan.pdf (2 pages), metrics_screenshot.png (chart)

Hi Julia / BrightCart Ops —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and for sharing the promo plan. We can support a provisional 6-hour burst window and a reconciled billing path as described below. Summary of what we will do:

1) Capacity uplift: provisional headroom approved for a 6-hour window starting 18:00 PT on Jul 1 (UTC 01:00 Jul 2). We will:
   - Raise per-route throughput to ~1.2M tokens/hr (equivalent to +250% of your committed baseline) for the window.
   - Enforce an automatic stop at window end unless you request an extension before the final 30 minutes.

2) Billing / reconciliation:
   - For this event only, overrun units billed at your standard overage rate but capped with a maximum surcharge of +15% above standard.
   - Redwood will apply a one-time pro-rated credit up to $3,000 against the event overrun (estimate based on provided traffic). Final credit will be reconciled after we review actual token usage and your promo metrics.
   - We will generate a provisional invoice and a reconciliation summary within 5 business days. Please review and sign the short acceptance so we can confirm the uplift (DocuSign link below).

3) Operational notes:
   - To minimize risk we will route requests to the verified low-latency runtime only. We cannot switch model families during the window.
   - If traffic exceeds the uplifted cap we will throttle to the cap and notify both BrightCart and Redwood on-call.

Next steps for you:
- Confirm start time if different from our provisional 18:00 PT start.
- Sign the short acceptance here: https://app.redwood.example/docuSign/BRG-4781-approval
- We attached an invoice estimate (estimate_billing.xlsx) and have preserved your promo plan and metrics in the case notes.

If this sounds good I’ll enable the headroom and send a final confirmation once routes are provisioned.

—Rafael
